actions.reason: Shop logs show connection refused to port 5015; payments connector listens on 5051 (typo).

root_causes.evidence: Shop logs: connection refused to 127.0.0.1:5015 on /charge, returning 502. The payments connector was running and listening on 5051, so the configured port was a typo.

report.summary: Checkout returned 502 because config.yaml pointed payments.url at port 5015, while the connector listens on 5051. I corrected the port and restarted shop. All 5 smoke tests now pass, and checkout returns 201 with the order persisted.
